cases.title: Double-click on the DP1 downpipe circle: AutoCAD's attribute editor is stopped first and CE's Edit source window opens (BUG-859, new switch ON)
cases.expected: A double-click on the outer circle of a freshly placed downpipe (tag DP1) opens CE's 'Edit source' window with DP1 in its tag box, and AutoCAD's Enhanced Attribute Editor does not open at all; CE's structured log says 'EATTEDIT stopped before AutoCAD's attribute editor opened ... source DP1' and 'CDEDIT scheduled at Idle'. The window has its Cancel and OK buttons; the title-bar Close closes it.
cases.why_not_unit: Unit tests pin CE's refusal of the lock request, but only real AutoCAD shows whether AutoCAD honours that refusal for an attribute editor started by a double-click, and which window the drafter sees.
not_automated: The red centre, the angled DP text and the green label (BUG-860) are not clicked here; only the outer circle named in the bug.
OK saving a changed tag is not driven (the press list has no OK for this window). Whether AutoCAD records an Undo step or ends the REDO window for the refused EATTEDIT is not read.

DERIVED, not yet seen on a run: the AutomationIds SourceEdit.Tag, SourceEdit.Cancel and SourceEdit.OK (from the XAML), the tag box value reading exactly DP1, and that the title-bar Close is pressable. If only these fail while checks 1 to 5 pass, the fix works and the case text needs one correction.
